verification.note: Stored on 16 Oct 2026: the Act as promulgated (法律第五十三号（令七・六・四）) on the House of Representatives' list of laws enacted in the 217th Diet (shugiin.go.jp; plain HTML, also rendered and printed); e-Gov's text of the Act with its revision history (browser render and print; the plain download is an empty JavaScript shell), which lists the revisions in force from 4 Jun 2025 and 1 Sep 2025 and marks the latter as current; and the Ministry of Justice's Japanese Law Translation page with its bilingual PDF. Stored on 11 Oct 2026: the Cabinet Office's AI Act page, its one-page Japanese overview and its provisional English translation of the overview. The texts confirm the title, the number, the commencement clause (Supplementary Provisions Article 1) and Articles 1 to 28; the summary is written from the Japanese text. The English title follows the Japanese Law Translation, which renders 人工知能 in full; the Cabinet Office's provisional overview uses 'AI-related Technology'. Enactment on 28 May 2025 comes from the Cabinet Office overviews, full commencement on 1 Sep 2025 from the Cabinet Office page and e-Gov's revision history.

judgment.status_reasoning: Supplementary Provisions Article 1 brings the Act into force on promulgation (4 Jun 2025), except Chapters III and IV and Supplementary Provisions Articles 3 and 4, which take effect on a day set by Cabinet Order within three months. e-Gov's revision history (stored 16 Oct 2026) lists the revisions in force from 4 Jun 2025 and 1 Sep 2025, both new enactment, and marks the 1 Sep 2025 revision as current (現在施行); the Cabinet Office page says the Act has been fully in force since 1 Sep 2025. No later revision is listed, so 'In force' stands and date_last_updated stays null.
